2608.28229.title: Stay Within Your Bounds: Distance-Guided Decoding for Guaranteed Context-Free Grammar Compliance
2608.28229.paper_summary: Grammar-constrained decoding helps large language models produce syntactically valid structured outputs, such as code, JSON, and SQL. For context-free grammars, many practical decoders enforce local prefix feasibility: each token must keep the current prefix extendable to some valid completion. Yet, under tokenizer-grammar mismatch and finite token budgets, feasible prefixes may still fail to reach acceptance. We propose a lookahead-guided decoding framework for context-free grammars based on pushdown automata. Offline, we compute bounded pushdown summaries with reachability labels and upper-bound distances to acceptance. Online, these estimates guide horizon-aware pruning and beam search. The resulting decoder is syntactically sound: every output is accepted by the target grammar. Experiments on JSON, SQL, and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) show both consistent syntactic validity and improved completion quality over existing baselines.
2608.28229.paper_summary_zh: 文法限制解碼幫助大型語言模型產生語法上有效的結構化輸出，例如代碼、JSON 和 SQL。對於無上下文文法，許多實用的解碼器強制執行局部前綴可行性：每個標記必須保持當前前綴可擴展到某個有效的完成。然而，在標記器與文法不匹配以及有限的標記預算下，可行的前綴仍可能無法達到接受。我們提出了一種基於下推自動機的無上下文文法的前瞻性引導解碼框架。在離線階段，我們計算帶有限的可達性標籤和到接受的上界距離的有界下推摘要。在在線階段，這些估計指導著考慮視野的剪枝和束搜索。最終的解碼器在語法上是健全的：每個輸出都被目標文法接受。在 JSON、SQL 和線性時間邏輯（LTL）上的實驗顯示出一致的語法有效性和相較於現有基準的改進完成質量。
